title: Photo's brush runs on SuiteKernel's stroke model and SuiteUI's pacer, pressure capture and cursor mark; Flare's pencil and Design's pen are built on the same module later, never as copies

ui_slice_reason: behaviour-preserving migration: no new screen; the apps' existing journeys and snapshots verify it (its UI slices swap an app view for the SuiteUI component the kernel's EK-chrome page already shows)

slices.behavior: Photo's brush, eraser, clone and heal sample through `StrokeSmoother` and `DabSpacer`, keep their options in `BrushSettings`, draw on `LiveCopy<PhotoWorkspace>` through SuiteUI's `StrokePacer`, `PointerPressure` and `BrushCursorMark`, and the Photo copies are deleted; the per-pixel capsule stays until creative-core's stamp op lands.
